pack.name: Starter sound effects pack
pack.note: A small bundled set of creator sound effects, every file CC0 (public domain dedication) so it can be used in any project, commercial or not, with no attribution required. Per-file records below were verified at ingestion: each Kenney pack page states 'License: Creative Commons CC0' and each downloaded pack zip contains a License.txt reading 'License: (Creative Commons Zero, CC0)'. Files are the original OGG Vorbis files from the pack zips, renamed only. Retrieved 2026-11-10.
